# ResumeRadar
> Free ATS resume scanner — no signup required

ResumeRadar is a free online tool that helps job seekers check their resume against a specific job description. Recruiters receive hundreds of applications per role, and ATS software plus AI screening rank every resume before a human reads it. ResumeRadar shows you how you rank: upload a resume (PDF/DOCX) and paste a job description to get an instant match score, missing keywords by category, ATS formatting checks, and AI-powered improvement suggestions.

## Features
- ATS match score with keyword analysis across 5 categories (technical skills, soft skills, certifications, education, action verbs)
- Missing keyword detection against the actual job description
- AI-powered resume suggestions, quick wins, and cover-letter talking points
- Free AI micro-tools: cover letter generator, bullet enhancer, summary generator
- ATS formatting and recruiter-tips sub-scores
- CV Builder: AI rewrites your CV for a target job — strict no-fabrication rules (no invented metrics, skills, or years of experience)

## Pricing
- Resume scan: free, no signup
- Standard Polish CV rewrite: £2 one-off (no subscription)
- Pro Review CV rewrite with senior-level gap analysis: £5 one-off
- Bundle credit packs available; Naira (Paystack) payment supported for Standard

## Role-specific checkers
Free ATS resume checkers with keyword guides for 15 roles, at
https://resumeradar.sholastechnotes.com/ats-resume-checker/ — including
software engineer, data analyst, cloud engineer, DevOps engineer, data
scientist, product manager, project manager, UX designer, cybersecurity
analyst, business analyst, solutions architect, frontend developer,
backend developer, scrum master, and machine learning engineer.

## URL
https://resumeradar.sholastechnotes.com

## Privacy
Resumes are analyzed in real time and are never added to a database, sold, or shared. Uploaded files are deleted immediately after parsing. Temporary data auto-expires: AI results are cached for up to 1 hour, and a generated CV is held for 2 hours so it can be downloaded, extended to 72 hours for a single purchase or to the remaining life of a bundle plan (up to 30 days). Emails are stored only as HMAC hashes; payment and email delivery are handled by Stripe and Resend.
